extractions.description: Introduces and evaluates DJINN, a diffusion model for jointly generating and conditionally editing multi-agent traffic trajectories, with experiments on Argoverse and INTERACTION.

type.quote: We train DJINN on two A100 GPUs for 150 epochs.
type.justification: The paper trains models and reports quantitative experiments and runtime measurements.

name.quote: In this paper, we present DJINN – a diffusion based method of generating traffic scenarios.
name.justification: The paper contributes a method for generating traffic scenarios.

name.quote: We evaluate the quality of sampled trajectories with both joint and ego-only motion forecasting
name.justification: The paper advances and evaluates joint and ego-only motion forecasting.

name.quote: Simulation of autonomous vehicle systems requires that simulated traffic participants exhibit diverse and realistic behaviors.
name.justification: Autonomous-vehicle simulation is the application domain addressed by the proposed method.

name.quote: DJINN is a diffusion model over the joint states of all agents in the scene.
name.justification: The work contributes a diffusion-based generative model and conditioning procedures.

name.quote: Diffuser [20] uses diffusion models to generate trajectories for offline reinforcement learning tasks.
name.justification: Offline reinforcement learning is discussed as related context rather than experimentally studied.
